explanation.text:
NORDIC MINING ASA (org.nr 989 796 739) is registered as Allmennaksjeselskap (ASA), founded 2006-02-23, registered 2006-05-08. Business address: Munkedamsveien 45 oppgang A, Vika Atrium, 0250 OSLO. Main industry (NACE): 07.290 Bryting av ikke-jernholdig malm ellers. Registered employees: 6 (as of 2026-04-10). Latest filed annual accounts (2025, company statement): revenue NOK 9,336,000; operating result NOK -42,021,000; net result NOK -7,935,000; total assets NOK 2,058,632,000; equity NOK 2,050,397,000 (the group statement for the same year reports revenue NOK 4,774,000). Leadership: general manager (daglig leder) Finn Ivar Marum; board chair Kjell Roland; 4 other board members. Sub-units registered: 1. Website: www.nordicmining.com. The website describes the company as: "Exploration and production of high-end minerals and metals" LEI: 5967007LIEEXZXFVKO54 (ACTIVE). Wikipedia: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nordic_Mining.

How each source was tied to this company:
- brreg_enheter: looked up by org number; record echoes the number
- brreg_roller: roles endpoint addressed by org number
- brreg_underenheter: sub-units filtered on overordnetEnhet = org number and re-checked
- brreg_regnskap: each filing's virksomhet.organisasjonsnummer verified
- gleif: LEI record's registeredAs equals the org number (Norwegian registration authority)
- wikidata: item carries P2333 = org number
- website: URL declared by the company in the registry; page match = orgnr_on_page (high)
